rows.note: Use this as the general noun for a handbook or a product manual, although 說明書 is more conversational for product instructions.

example.english: This manual is very clear; just follow it.
example.traditional: 呢本手冊寫得好清楚，跟住做就得喇。
example.jyutping: ne1 bun2 sau2 caak3 se2 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2 gan1 zyu6 zou6 zau6 dak1 laa3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something operated or carried out manually rather than automatically.

example.english: This machine has to be switched to manual before the door can open.
example.traditional: 呢部機要轉做手動先可以開門。
example.jyutping: ne1 bou6 gei1 jiu1 zyun2 zou6 sau2 dung6 sin1 ho2 ji5 hoi1 mun4

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that people, rather than automation, do the work, including manual checks and work done by hand.

example.english: This batch needs manual checking, one piece at a time.
example.traditional: 呢批貨要靠人手逐件檢查。
example.jyutping: ne1 pai1 fo3 jiu3 kaau3 jan4 sau2 zuk6 gin6 gim2 caa4

rows.note: Use this for a vehicle with a manual transmission, contrasting with 自動波.

example.english: I want to buy a manual car; it is more fun to drive.
example.traditional: 我想買架手波車，揸落有趣啲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 gaa3 sau2 bo1 ce1 zaa1 lok6 jau5 ceoi3 di1

rows.note: Use this when a device or control is set to manual rather than automatic operation.

example.english: When I take night photos, I switch to manual mode and adjust the exposure myself.
example.traditional: 影夜景嗰陣，我會轉去手動模式，自己較曝光。
example.jyutping: jing2 je6 ging2 go2 zan6 ngo5 wui5 zyun2 heoi3 sau2 dung6 mou4 sik1 zi6 gei2 gaau3 buk6 gwong1

rows.note: Use this mainly for goods or production made by hand, especially handmade or craft items, not for operating a machine.

example.english: These leather shoes are made with manual craftsmanship, not mass-produced by machine.
example.traditional: 呢啲皮鞋係手工造，唔係機器大量生產。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 pei4 haai4 hai6 sau2 gung1 zou6 m4 hai6 gei1 hei3 daai6 loeng6 sang1 caan2
